english.title: Raves - failure to leave land

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: CRIMINAL JUSTICE AND PUBLIC ORDER ACT 1994

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), knowing that a direction applicable to you had been given under section 63(2) of the Criminal Justice and Public Order Act 1994, failed to leave the land, namely **(..SPECIFY LAND..), as soon as reasonably practicable
english.legislation: Contrary to section 63(6)(a) of the Criminal Justice and Public Order Act 1994.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
knowing direction to leave land under section 63(2) applied
failed to comply with order
as soon as reasonably practicable

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) The direction does not have to be given in writing and may be communicated by an constable at the scene.
(ii) Certain persons are exempt.

other.penalty:
Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
